messages:
Billing Ops: Heads up — customer Pinnacle Health (acct PH-992) reported invoice INV-20345 missing PO number. They expect PO PO-98234 but invoice shows empty "purchase_order" field. Can someone take?
James P: on it. Do we have the invoice JSON or portal screenshot?
Billing Ops: Uploaded screenshot in ticket #4567 but here's the API response slice we pulled from billing service: ```json
{
  "invoice_id": "INV-20345",
  "customer": "Pinnacle Health",
  "amount": 12750.00,
  "purchase_order": null,
  "status": "paid"
}
```
Support Bot: Automated note: invoice INV-20345 settled on 2026-02-11 via charge CHG-7781. No webhook errors recorded.
Alex K: Looks like ERP sync job `erp-sync-v2` ran on 2026-02-12 and a mapping rule dropped PO if vendor_id mismatch. Could be that. Recommend backfill + credit-rebill since invoice already paid.
James P: Proposed steps: 1) Finance creates a credit for INV-20345, 2) reissue corrected invoice with PO=PO-98234, 3) trigger balance transfer to original payment method or issue manual refund depending on customer preference. Any objections?
Finance Priya: Ok to create credit note and reissue. Prefer refund->charge flow for full paid invoices unless customer asks to keep charge and record internal memo. Need exact GL codes — @Billing Ops can you provide ledger entries?
Billing Ops: GL: Revenue 4001, Credit note uses 6102. I'll attach a small runbook snippet: ```bash
# create credit via billing-api
curl -X POST https://billing.redwood.ai/v1/invoices/INV-20345/credits \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $BILLING_TOKEN' \n  -d '{"reason":"PO added post-pay","amount":12750.00,"metadata":{"po":"PO-98234","erp_ref":"ERP-5567"}}'
```
CS Lin: Called customer. They prefer we reissue and apply refund to the same card. They provided PO doc (attached).
James P: I'll run the credit then reissue flow. Quick repro notes for engineering: replicate by running `erp-sync-v2 --check-mappings --dry-run` against PH-992; there is a vendor id mismatch rule.
Alex K: Filed an infra bug to relax the drop rule and add logging: INFRA-1298. No regression risk.
James P: Action items: (1) Billing Ops add GL codes to ticket, (2) Finance executes credit+refund and reissue, (3) Engineering fixes mapping rule in next patch. I'll post final invoice link here once done. :white_check_mark:
Billing Ops: GL codes added to ticket, added `erp_ref` to metadata.
Support Bot: Update: credit created CN-7701, refund initiated RF-9922, new invoice issued INV-20345-R1 with PO=PO-98234.
CS Lin: Customer confirmed refund received. Thanks team! :tada:
James P: Closing thread — notes pushed to ticket #4567 and runbook updated at https://redwood.internal/runbooks/billing/po-backfill.md
